item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Fable and Mythos 5.2: The System Card
item.description: Zvi's line-by-line read of the Mythos 5.2 system card: Anthropic's own numbers put AI R&D acceleration at ~1.9x, past its 2x threshold, and the S-1 quietly admits the threshold is met — plus a near-doubling in AECI capability scores.

item.title: Scott Aaronson: Dana's talk on OpenAI's proof of the Unique Games Conjecture, now on YouTube!
item.description: A 3-hour lecture on the AI-discovered proof of the Unique Games Conjecture — where the Long Code and Hadamard Code attempts got stuck, and how the new tree-based code gets around them.
